caption: The drawing features two large, stylized pink flowers with yellow and blue accents, each having multiple rounded petals, positioned symmetrically on either side of a central green stem. The flowers are connected by curving, dark green stems accented with a lighter green and a central pink stripe running through them, giving a sense of movement across the composition. Small green leaves with varying shades of green and blue extend outward from the stems. Above the central stem, near the top of the drawing, is a small bird rendered in shades of brown, gray, and pink, facing to the left and perched on a short branch with small pink blossoms. The background is a light beige color, and the initials "L.P." and the date "1764" are written in small letters below the flowers near the center of the image.
title: Crewel Bed Hanging
